verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day mission" (R2); "9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" approx. 10 days, "crewed lunar flyby mission" (R3); "MISSION DURATION 9 Days, 1 Hour, 32 Minutes" (R4); "The 10-day Artemis II mission" (R5); "about 10 days" (R6); "10-day mission" (R8, R9); "approximately 10-day mission" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe it as a ~10-day crewed test mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey" (R2); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems" (R3); "test Orion’s life-support systems" (R5); "validate Orion, SLS and mission operations" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported as testing/validating Orion in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "second flight of the Space Launch System (SLS)" but SLS launches to orbit, not deep space (R3); SLS is launch vehicle, Orion goes to deep space (R4, R5, R8)
verifications.reasoning: SLS is tested during launch/ascent, not in deep space; contradicts claim attributing deep space validation to SLS.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "life support and deep-space communications" (R2); "life support systems" tested (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts" (R5); "demonstrate life support systems" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states validation of life-support in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed mission to the moon in more than 50 years" (R2, R6); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3); "first crewed moon mission in 50 years" (R5, R8)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as first crewed lunar mission since Apollo >50 years ago.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft" around moon (R1); "four astronauts toward space... around the moon" (R2); "Crew size 4" lunar flyby (R3); "fly four astronauts around the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm four astronauts on lunar flyby/circum-lunar path.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to test systems for future lunar landings and eventual Mars missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration... to Mars" (R1); "clear a path for... new lunar landing... journeys farther out" (R2); "supporting subsequent Artemis missions... lunar surface" (R3); "paving the way for future lunar surface missions" (R4); "paving the way for the Artemis III mission" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supports testing for future lunar/Mars missions.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test essential life support systems" with crew (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicit match.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support systems" includes environmental control (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Life-support encompasses environmental control, but not explicitly named; broader terms used.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: " Guidance, navigation, and communications" (R8); navigation tests in high Earth orbit (R3); star trackers/navigation (R2 context)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly includes navigation system tests.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1); "four astronauts... lunar journey... around the moon" (R2); "Crewed lunar flyby" with 4 (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II journey passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "4,000 miles above the surface"; "4,067 mi" closest approach (R3); "more than 4,100 miles from the surface" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify ~4,000-4,100 miles from surface, not 4,700; numerical mismatch.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch... first woman to venture into deep space" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" beyond LEO (R3); "first woman to go to the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states Koch as first woman beyond LEO/deep space.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover... first Black man to venture into deep space" (R2); "Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct attribution to Glover.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen... first person on a moon mission who is not an American"; "first Canadian" (R2); "Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly Hansen as first Canadian beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth: 252,799 miles" (R2); "set the record for human distance from Earth" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Mission sets new distance record beyond previous human flights.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis III.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" incl. III (R3); "paving the way for... Artemis III" (R4, R9)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly prepares for Artemis III.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis IV.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" (R3); general prep for program incl. later missions (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Prepares overall program including IV, but primarily emphasizes III; broader support.

verifications.claim: Future missions after Artemis II will land humans on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "returning humans to the moon... lunar base" (R1); "new lunar landing" (R2); "returning humans to the lunar surface" (R3); "future lunar surface missions" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Program goals post-II include landings.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander" (R2); "commander Reid Wiseman" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently named as commander.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Victor Glover, who is scheduled to pilot" (R1); "Victor Glover, the Artemis II pilot" (R2, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly pilot.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch... mission specialist" (R2); "mission specialist Christina Koch" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen... mission specialist" (R2); "mission specialist Jeremy Hansen" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match.
